subject: Exec day: checkpoint lane & credential handoff plan (Hearthstone Financial)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Luis Gonzalez <luis.gonzalez@hearthstone.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Exec day: checkpoint lane & credential handoff plan (Hearthstone Financial)

Hi Luis + team,

Thanks again for hosting the executive day on May 24. Attached is our initial attendee_manifest.xlsx with names and arrival windows. We want to lock the checkpoint-lane flow so execs can be processed quickly without standing in the main lobby. Proposed high-level: 

- 06:15–07:00: arrival window for exec vehicles at loading dock B (north).
- 06:20–06:40: expedited badge printing at satellite table outside conference hall (checkpoint lane).
- 06:40–07:00: credential handoff to on-site liaison; escorted to private elevator.

Questions for you:
1) Can Hearthstone provide a single security POC for badge printing & KBA confirmation?
2) Is there a preferred badge template we should use (we can adapt yours) — I attached a sample to illustrate required fields.
3) Any vehicle staging constraints or proof-of-insurance we should collect ahead of time?

Action items I'd like to confirm this week so we can print manifests for arrival staff: 
- Confirm security POC and cell number.
- Confirm whether scratch photo badges (photo-on-file) will be accepted or if photos must be taken on arrival.
- Confirm a secure handoff process for guest devices (if any).

Attachments: [Attachment: attendee_manifest.xlsx]

Appreciate a quick reply — we need the POC to brief our contract security and the badge vendor.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Events Lead
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0190
From: Luis Gonzalez <luis.gonzalez@hearthstone.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hearthstone Security <security@hearthstone.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Exec day: checkpoint lane & credential handoff plan (Hearthstone Financial)

Kimberly — thanks for the clear plan. A few quick answers: 

- Security POC: Luis Gonzalez (me) and on-site lead Sasha Park (sasha.park@hearthstone.com, cell +1 212-555-4032). Please coordinate final manifest with Sasha for badge printing.
- Badge template: we have a visitor_badge_template.pdf attached. It includes a QR header we scan at the lobby and a secondary foil sticker for restricted rooms. The print vendor can produce both at your table.
- Photos: we prefer photos-on-file for execs; if your manifest has headshots included we can skip on-site photos.
- Vehicle staging: loading dock B is fine for drop-off. Please have vehicles display the temporary placard number (we will send the placard ids once you confirm drivers).

I attached the badge template and a short security note. Sasha will meet you Wednesday 17:00 ET for a quick site walk if that helps.

Attachments: [Attachment: visitor_badge_template.pdf]

—Luis
Luis Gonzalez
Director, Facilities & Events
Hearthstone Financial
luis.gonzalez@hearthstone.com | +1 (212) 555-0104
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec day: checkpoint lane & credential handoff plan (Hearthstone Financial)

Kimberly / Aditya —

Thanks Luis. Couple of internal notes and asks before we finalize: 

- Compliance: we need to confirm whether Hearthstone will accept our vendor KBA (key background attestation) for the badge printer team. If not, we will need their staff to check in under vendor escort every time.
- Audit trail: please confirm whether badge scans are retained for 90 days (we need logs for any post-event investigations). If Hearthstone retains only 30 days we need to surface that to Legal.
- Escort plan: Evelyn, can you confirm executive escort pairings (which Redwood execs need 1:1 security vs. group escort)?

Marissa
Senior Events Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Looping in operational details from our side. Key updates: 

- Satellite table setup: we will position a 6ft table 10ft north of conference hall entrance. Vendor will bring a laptop, thermal badge printer, and a secure lockbox for printed badges.
- Checkpoint map attached (checkpoint_map.png) with recommended queue cones and one-way flow; do not allow public foot traffic through the table.
- Printed_badge_manifest.csv: I will bring two copies (one to hand to Hearthstone security, one kept inside lockbox). Both copies will have only name, company, and access tier — no PII beyond that.
- Handoff procedure:
  1) Badge printed and signed by Redwood print vendor.
  2) Vendor places printed badges in lockbox; lockbox opened by Sasha (Hearthstone) only.
  3) Sasha verifies ID and signs the printed_badge_manifest.csv line-item.
  4) Sasha escorts the guest to the private elevator.

Operational asks for Hearthstone: please confirm that Sasha is authorized to open the lockbox and sign the manifest. Also confirm whether the QR header on your badge template is scannable by our handhelds.

Attachments: [Attachment: checkpoint_map.png] [Attachment: printed_badge_manifest.csv]

—Aditya
Security Ops Lead (contract security coordination)
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0211
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Luis Gonzalez <luis.gonzalez@hearthstone.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Sasha Park <sasha.park@hearthstone.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec day: checkpoint lane & credential handoff plan (Hearthstone Financial)

All — thank you, this is great and much clearer. Final confirmations before we lock prints: 

- Sasha is confirmed as lockbox signer and liaison (Luis, please confirm Sasha has on-site authority to open and sign).
- We will include headshots in the final_manifest.csv (attached) so you can use photos-on-file and skip on-site photography.
- Drop-off timing: vehicle placards will be sent by end of day Monday; planned arrival for Redwood exec coach is 06:25. Can we please confirm a security escort to the private elevator at 06:30 so the execs are in the suite by 06:35?
- Audit logs: Marissa — Luis confirmed retention of badge scans for 90 days in his note; Luis, please confirm in reply that 90-day retention is correct so I can close this with Legal.

I will bring one printed copy of final_manifest.csv to hand to Sasha at the satellite table and one sealed copy to retain with our ops kit. Thanks everyone for rapid coordination.

Attachments: [Attachment: final_manifest.csv]

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Events Lead
Redwood Inference
